Weddings

A wedding countdown you share with your partner

The big day deserves more than a calendar entry. Put the countdown on both your Home Screens, keep the to-do list next to it, and share it so you both see the same thing.

Why couples use Simple Count for the wedding

  • Count Down Together: share the wedding countdown with your partner by link. If either of you changes the date, the photo or the notes, it updates on both phones and both widgets. Sharing one countdown is free.
  • The checklist lives with the countdown: use sections in the notes for Venue, Guests, Suppliers and Honeymoon, with checklists you can tick off together. Attach the venue contract or a photo of the dress swatch with Pro.
  • Your photo on the widget: put a photo of the two of you behind the day count on your Home Screen (Pro, one-time).
  • Reminders that count back: one month, one week and one day before, for the things that always come up last minute.

After the wedding

The countdown doesn't disappear. Past events stay in a Past tab and count the days since, so the same card becomes your "married for 100 days" counter. Make an anniversary countdown that repeats yearly and it's ready every year.

Questions

Can both of us see the same wedding countdown?

Yes. Share it with Count Down Together and it stays linked: the date, photo and notes update on both phones, widgets included. Joining is always free.

Is there a subscription?

No. Simple Count is free with every widget; Pro is an optional one-time purchase.
